summary: Meridian should keep its standalone municipal control row. Official city materials show an active Meridian Police Department, and the official sheriff website says municipal police departments patrol their own city limits while the sheriff assists when necessary, which rules against a sheriff-primary replacement theory. Mississippi's own public reporting shows that Meridian Police Department was not yet present on the 2024 TOPS reporting surface, then appears as a separate certified agency and separate 2025 reporting row later in 2025. The current all-fill state is therefore a pre-2025 reporting-transition and continuity gap on MS0380100, not an invalid municipal target.
